records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings deck — USDC product balances, market position and derivatives strategy
records.note: Official deck reports Q3 average USDC held in Coinbase products of USD22B, approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization of USD73B; the product metric includes corporate USDC and USDC held on behalf of customers in eligible Coinbase products. Coinbase says the Q3 average reflects the full-quarter impact of the Hyperliquid USDC balance that arrived in June, and claims it captured approximately 50% of USDC economics over the prior year. The latter is a company claim. The deck reports 10.7% global crypto trading-volume share, fourth consecutive quarter of share gains, 179% two-year CAGR in derivatives volume, and October INTX/Deribit integration. The USD22B average product balance is not the same metric as Q3-end USDC AOP of USD8.616B in the 10-Q.

records.title: Circle launches Arc public mainnet — USDC-native gas, institutional validators and SBI participation
records.note: Circle announced Arc public mainnet on 2026-09-16. Circle says fees are paid in USDC with no volatile native token required; Circle Payments Network and StableFX are integrated; the network uses a permissioned validator set and a phased founding-validator cohort including SBI Group. SBI CEO Yoshitaka Kitao said SBI will contribute to network operation/governance and intends to leverage USDC and JPYSC in the collaboration. Circle lists Coinbase and Binance among digital-asset exchanges providing access to Arc, but the release does not specify their precise production integration scope. The release describes more than 100 institutional/ecosystem builders live on or exploring the private mainnet before public launch; not all are proven production integrations. Circle's claims about agent-driven volume and adoption are company-reported.
